# Mobile client

## Goal
A small mobile client for Acme customers to browse the catalogue and place orders. It talks to the existing Acme API and never stores payment details.

## State
Idea raised by the CEO on 2026-11-17. Feasibility discussed in chat: the API already covers catalogue and orders. Requirements settled and decided (decision 0001). Engineering spike done on 2026-11-17: a prototype lists the catalogue and places a test order; findings in this folder.

## Next step
Engineering builds the MVP in https://github.com/example-owner/acme-app (private, created on 2026-11-17 with the CEO's OK on ACME-A35).
